facts.note: The region east to west: four trees at the corners of a square 42-44 apart, with the forest round them.
The region north to south, the same as its span.
From y 56, under the lowest gully, to y 143, over the Watch Crown's top at y 122.
Trunk centre to trunk centre along the north side, which the Long Bridge spans.
Trunk centre to trunk centre along the south side, which no bridge spans.
Trunk centre to trunk centre along the west side, which the Low Bridge spans.
Trunk centre to trunk centre along the east side, which the High Bridge spans.
The Root Glade's walk plane on the Hearth Tree's high shelf.
The Hearth House floor: 14 rungs of rope ladder over the glade, the highest house.
The Loom House and the two bridges that leave it: 20 over the gully floor.
The Seed House and the Low Bridge.
The plank landing at the Watch Tree's first fork, 9 rungs over the Watch House.
The Watch Crown from its landing to its top at y 122; the Crown Lookout ring stands at y 112 inside it.
A rope bridge's deck, three planks wide.
